claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_spell_save_dc
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The robe grants a passive bonus to the wearer's global spell save DC, and the current surface has no atom for that concept. Existing DC override support only applies to casts made through a specific granted spell access.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your spell save DC and spell attack bonus each increase by 2.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_ac_formula_replacement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can express base-AC replacement only inside spell ongoing operations, not inside passive magic-item grants. The robe needs the same AC-formula shape under an unarmored equipment gate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 15 plus your Dexterity modifier.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.save_source_filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Saving-throw advantage can be authored today, but it cannot be restricted to spells and other magical effects. Encoding blanket advantage on all saving throws would be dishonest.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
